1: In January 2019, CT scan showed no lymphoma relapse but diffuse subcutaneous edema.
2: Laboratory tests showed elevated LDH and CK, with negative autoimmune serology.
3: Systemic steroids and a short discontinuation of ibrutinib had no effect.
4: Neurologic exam showed only weak symmetric fist closure and shoulder lift; no focal deficits.
6: Muscle biopsy demonstrated interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates with variation in fiber size, centrally located nuclei, necrosis, and regeneration.
